ht.badge: Regulated by Ministry of Health Malaysia
ht.subtitle: Permanent Surgical Solution for Hair Loss
ht.heroDesc1: Hair transplant surgery is a medically established procedure that restores hair by relocating healthy hair follicles from donor areas to thinning or balding regions. In Malaysia, hair transplant procedures must be performed in licensed medical facilities under regulated clinical standards.
ht.heroDesc2: Medical and surgical procedures are overseen by the Ministry of Health Malaysia, ensuring practitioner qualifications, patient safety, and ethical care.
ht.whatIsDesc: A hair transplant is a surgical procedure in which hair follicles are harvested from genetically resistant donor areas (usually the back or sides of the scalp) and implanted into areas affected by hair loss.
ht.mayoNote: The Mayo Clinic recognizes hair transplantation as a permanent solution for pattern hair loss when performed by trained professionals using proper technique.
ht.causesDesc: Hair loss may occur due to:
ht.cause0: Androgenetic alopecia (male or female pattern baldness)
ht.clevelandNote: Clinical guidance from the Cleveland Clinic notes that androgenetic alopecia is the most common cause of progressive hair thinning in both men and women.
ht.techTitle: Hair Transplant Techniques Used in Malaysia
ht.techDesc: Technique selection depends on hair loss pattern, donor density, and long-term planning:
ht.tech1Point1: Higher graft yield in selected cases
ht.tech1Point3: Technique selection depends on hair loss pattern
ht.safetyDesc1: Hair transplant surgery is considered safe when performed under sterile conditions by trained medical professionals.
ht.safetyDesc2: Principles of procedural safety and patient consent align with international standards outlined by the World Health Organization (WHO) for safe surgical care.
ht.safetyNote: Preoperative evaluation ensures appropriate candidacy and minimizes risks.
ht.recoveryDesc: Post-operative recovery follows timelines consistent with guidance from major healthcare systems such as the NHS.
ht.candidateDesc: You may be suitable if you:
ht.cand4: Understand the gradual nature of results
ht.importantDesc1: A thorough consultation ensures the right technique, natural design, and long-term planning for optimal results.
ht.importantDesc2: Hair transplant results are gradual - patience is key to achieving your desired outcome.

ht.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about hair transplant
ht.faq0A: A surgical procedure that relocates hair follicles to balding or thinning areas.
ht.faq1A: Yes. Transplanted hair follicles are genetically resistant to hair loss.
ht.faq2A: Discomfort is minimal and controlled with local anesthesia.
ht.faq3A: Most patients return to work within 3-7 days.
ht.faq4A: New growth starts around 4 months, with full results by 12 months.
ht.faq5A: Initial shedding is normal; permanent growth follows.
ht.faq6A: FUE leaves tiny dot scars; FUT leaves a linear scar hidden by hair.
ht.faq7A: Yes, when performed by qualified doctors in regulated facilities.
